description: Every tracked dependency lockfile or manifest covered by the required ordinary scan or the separate non-required frozen-evidence-risk workflow. A lockfile entry without a parser lets OSV-Scanner infer it from the file name; parser names the OSV-Scanner v2 extractor for names it cannot infer (--lockfile=<parser>:<path>). A covered_by_lockfile entry is a manifest OSV-Scanner v2.6.0 has no source extractor for; its sibling lockfile is scanned instead. A dependency_free entry is a package.json that declares no dependency and has no lockfile beside it, so nothing is scanned for it; it needs a reason and an evidence path. An excluded entry is a tracked lockfile deliberately left out of the scan; it needs a reason and an evidence path, and a deliberately vulnerable test fixture or captured evidence lock that is not a live input qualifies. An entry naming the dedicated frozen-report config is scanned without exceptions by its own reporting workflow; all other entries use .github/osv-scanner.toml in the required scan. Required preflight checks retain exhaustive/disjoint coverage, artifact digest and inactive-eligibility bindings. An explicit --config applies to every input of one invocation. tests/test_osv_lockfile_coverage.py fails when a tracked dependency input is in none of the four lists.
